meta.description: Downtown Montreal dental clinic since 1997. 980 Sainte-Catherine Ouest. Call 514-861-5252. Monday–Friday 9:00–19:00.

home.title: Beausourire
home.lead: Kids and adults at 980 Sainte-Catherine Ouest, suite 200. Book by phone — they do not publish an online calendar.
home.bookLead: This site does not book a slot. Their live homepage has no calendar. Call, or fill the form they already host.
home.svcLead: Names from their menu. They do not publish treatment write-ups or a fee list — we do not invent either.
home.placeLead: Business core of Montreal, as they write it. Suite 200.
home.hoursNote: As printed on the homepage sidebar. No weekend emergency number on the site we read.
home.aboutLead: Complete dental care for children and adults, downtown. They write that they stay current by investing in equipment and staff training.
home.alertHint: Desk can flip a snow-day bar without a developer. File: content/ops.json or /admin.

locations.title: Location
locations.lead: 980 Sainte-Catherine Ouest, suite 200 — business core, as they write it.
locations.note: Weekends closed. They do not publish metro directions on the current homepage; the address is enough to map.

appointments.title: Book
appointments.lead: This site does not book a slot. Call during hours, or use the registration form on their live site.
appointments.hoursNote: Monday–Friday 9:00–19:00. Saturday and Sunday closed — as on the homepage sidebar.
appointments.emailNote: info@beausourire.com is on the homepage. We do not treat email as a booking desk.
appointments.urgentLead: If this cannot wait and the clinic is closed: 911 or a hospital emergency room.

team.title: Team
team.lead: Their old “Notre équipe” link is a 404. We do not invent dentist names. Call the desk, or use the form on their site.

clinic.title: About
clinic.lead: Conveniently located in the business heart of Montreal, complete dental care for kids and adults — as they write it in English. Established in 1997.
clinic.tech: They say they stayed hi-tech by investing in equipment and staff training. The technology page has no body text; the photo is an original iPhone.

contact.title: Contact
contact.emailNote: Printed on the homepage. Does not book a visit.

services.title: Services

walkin.title: Urgent care

walkin.hoursConflict: No after-hours number on the site we scraped.
walkin.item2: New patients: their confidential form on beausourire.com
walkin.item4: After hours: 911 or a hospital ER
